verdict.rationale: Gusto is expanding into an all-in-one small-business operations platform covering payroll, HR, compliance, formation and banking, so contract workflow is a plausible axis for it. However, none of the evidence documents drafting, negotiating, or redlining contracts in a controlled workflow. The compliance features cover state filings, registered agent service, and mail monitoring, and Gusto explicitly says it is not legal advice; none of this amounts to contract lifecycle management.
